A personal profile
english cinema club.
★ 0 / 0

Today you write your own personal profile, like a star’s page on a film website. First we look at people, then we read two profiles, and then we write yours. Collect stars ★

01

Warm-up: describe people

Look at the people. Choose one person and say three sentences. Help:

This is a boy / girl / man / woman.
He / She has got … hair and … eyes.
He / She wears ….

Who is it?

Read the description and tap the right photo.

Test 1: What do you know?

Choose the word. Don’t worry if you don’t know it. You learn from the answers!

Appearance words

Read the words and the explanations. Say the words aloud. (Tap a word to hear it.)

Test 2: Choose the right word

02

Meet Mia and Leo

Look at the photos. Say two sentences about Mia and two about Leo. What do they look like?

Mia

Hi! I’m Mia. I’m twelve and I’m in Year seven. I live in a flat near my school, so I walk to school in ten minutes. I’ve got a mum, a dad and two brothers. I’m friendly and honest. I’m keen on drawing and I play tennis with my friends at the weekend. I’ve got a cat called Coco. My ambition is to be a vet.

Leo

Hello! My name’s Leo. I’m thirteen and I’m in Year eight. I live in a house in a small town. I go to school by bus. I’ve got a sister, Emma. My favourite subjects are maths and PE. I listen to music every day and I play the guitar. I’m creative and hard-working.

① Tick the information

What information does each person include? Tap Mia and / or Leo in each line.

② Questions

Choose the right answer.

③ Ask and answer

Work with your teacher. Student A asks about Mia. Student B asks about Leo. Then swap.
1. What year is Mia / Leo in?
2. What are Mia’s / Leo’s hobbies?
3. What is Mia’s / Leo’s ambition?

What do they say about themselves?

Read the profiles again. Choose the adjectives.

04

Key phrases

Write about yourself. Complete the phrases with at, in, to or with. Some prepositions are used more than once.

Contractions

Writing Strategy: In letters to friends and family, emails and other informal texts we can use contractions: I’m = I am, she’s = she is, I’ve = I have, don’t = do not.

Say it in full

05

Plan and write

Writing Strategy: Always write in paragraphs. A paragraph has two or more sentences about the same topic. Make a plan first!

① Plan

Choose 3 or 4 topics for your profile.

② Write your profile

One paragraph for each topic. Use contractions. Begin like this: Hi! I’m … I’m … years old.

Paragraph 1 – topic:
Paragraph 2 – topic:
Paragraph 3 – topic:

③ Check your work

★

Homework

Write in your notebook. Then send a photo of the page to your teacher. (15–20 minutes)

1. People I know (10 minutes)
Write 6 sentences about 6 different people (Alisa, mum, dad, a friend, your coach…). Use 6 different adjectives from the list.
Example: My sister Alisa is hard-working. She does her homework every day.
2. Looks (5 minutes)
Write 4 sentences. Describe a person and your cat or chinchilla.
Example: My mum has got long, straight, dark hair. She’s of medium height.
3. Spelling (5 minutes)
Read the clue. Write the adjective. Don’t look at the list!
